blocks.text: If you’ve ever been impressed by the restrooms at Incheon International Airport, you’re not alone. One of them just won the Presidential Award at South Korea’s 28th Beautiful Restroom Awards. The winning restroom, located near Gate 225 in Terminal 2’s duty-free area, stands out for its floor-to-ceiling windows offering views of planes taking off and landing. Organizers say the restrooms are evaluated based on cleanliness, convenience, safety, design and maintenance, in which this particular restroom ticked all of the boxes.
